answers.genPolicy:cff417720bcd3ea200a595a71a588f:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .

[B2] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .

[B3] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > < deviceB | 'key' : DeviceKey , ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'key' : FreshKey , ... > < deviceB | 'key' : FreshKey , ... > if DeviceKey =/= nils .

[B4] < cloudA | 'secret' : Secret , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX , Rest) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'signKey' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key)
=> < cloudA | 'secret' : Secret , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX , Rest) , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'signedKey' UserX | (deviceB ; encrypt(Key,Secret)) .

[B4] < UserX | 'signedKey' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'signedKey' UserX | (deviceB ; SignedKey)
=> < UserX | 'signedKey' : SignedKey , ... > .

[B5] < UserX | 'signedKey' : encrypt(Key,Secret) , ... > < deviceB | 'key' : Key , 'secret' : Secret , 'trusted' : Trusted , ... > $ UserX 'bind' deviceB | encrypt(Key,Secret)
=> < UserX | 'signedKey' : encrypt(Key,Secret) , ... > < deviceB | 'key' : Key , 'secret' : Secret , 'trusted' : (UserX , Trusted) , ... > .

[B6] < cloudA | deviceB : ('trusted' : Trusted , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'shareAccess' cloudA | (deviceB ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserY , Trusted) , ...) , ... > .

[B7] < cloudA | deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY , Rest) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' cloudA | (deviceB ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX , Rest) , ...) , ... > .
